create_ticker: create a Ticker instance with tick_rate, step_rate, ip, and port parameters
start_ticker: start the Ticker to step the Minecraft world via SocketIO at the configured step_rate
run_ticker_cli: run the ticker module directly to step a Minecraft world on localhost:6002 every 0.2 seconds
review_ticker_class: review the Ticker class that polls and emits step_world events over SocketIO
refactor_ticker_start: refactor the Ticker start method to add graceful shutdown or configurable initialization delay
